items.a: The 50 takes about a one-bedroom flat — roughly 40 medium boxes, or 25 boxes with a sofa. The 90 takes a two to three-bedroom home. If you are between the two, tell us what you have and we will say which one, including if that is the smaller.
Yes. Access is seven days a week. Office hours are shorter, so if you need to speak to somebody, come on a weekday.
items.q: Can I get in at the weekend?

items.a: No deposit. The first month is payable when you move in, and that is the whole of it.
It is monthly and rolling. One month's notice on either side. There is no minimum term and no penalty for leaving.
items.q: How long do I have to commit to?

items.a: You do, and only you. You fit your own padlock and we do not keep a copy. Staff cannot open your unit.
Yes, and many do. The 90 takes about twelve stacked pallets. Tell us if you will be coming and going daily so we can put you near the door.
Nothing perishable, living, flammable, explosive, or illegal. If you are unsure about something, ask before you bring it.
We have trolleys and a loading bay, and we will point you at a mover we trust. We do not move things ourselves.

text: Something not answered here? Ask us — we would rather answer it before you sign than after.
